description: This file is an implementation of the LoanProductReadPlatformService interface in Java. It handles retrieval of loan product data from a database, including details like charges, rates, borrower variations, advanced payments, credit allocations, and floating rate details. It uses JDBC templates and mappers to query and map data from SQL result sets to Java data objects, supporting various retrieval scenarios such as by ID, external ID, currency, and for lookups or combinations.

classes.name: LoanProductReadPlatformServiceImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a service to read loan product details from the database, including mapping SQL data to domain objects.

classes.name: LoanProductMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping result set to LoanProductData during detailed loan product retrieval.

classes.name: LoanProductLookupMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for simplified loan product lookup Data.

classes.name: AdvancedPaymentDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping advanced payment rules from database.

classes.name: CreditAllocationDataMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for mapping credit allocation rules.

classes.name: LoanProductBorrowerCycleMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for borrower cycle variation data.

classes.name: LoanProductFloatingRateMapper
classes.description: RowMapper for floating interest rate details for loan products.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProduct
methods.description: Retrieves detailed information about a specific loan product by its ID, including charges, rates, variations, and configurations.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductByExternalId
methods.description: Fetches a loan product using its external identifier.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductBorrowerCycleVariations
methods.description: Gets borrower cycle variations associated with a loan product.

methods.name: retrieveAdvancedPaymentData
methods.description: Gets advanced payment rules for a specific loan product.

methods.name: retrieveCreditAllocationData
methods.description: Gets credit allocation rules for a loan product.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProducts
methods.description: Retrieves all loan products, possibly filtered by user access.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProductsForLookup
methods.description: Fetches a simplified list of all loan products for lookup purposes, with optional active-only filtering.

methods.name: retrieveAllLoanProductsForCurrency
methods.description: Retrieves loan products for a specific currency.

methods.name: retrieveAvailableLoanProductsForMix
methods.description: Fetches loan products available for portfolio mix.

methods.name: retrieveRestrictedProductsForMix
methods.description: Gets products that are restricted for a portfolio mix based on a product ID.

methods.name: retrieveAllowedProductsForMix
methods.description: Gets products allowed for a portfolio mix relative to a given product.

methods.name: retrieveLoanProductFloatingDetails
methods.description: Retrieves floating interest rate details for a specific loan product.
